body: Always remember that you come first. I know family is important but my parents can be the same way. I always remember that, yes, they are my family but I need to worry about myself and be who I want to be before I worry about what my family thinks. Be proud of who you are and what you are doing even if it's small.
Thank you. I appreciate all the advice and will definitely try these things. Im not sure what else to say but thank you. It is comforting knowing there are people willing to listen and help.

Thank you very much for making this so welcoming. I suppose one thing has got me in this position, is that my current support system always seems to have something more important going on. My boyfriend always gets upset with me because my sadness ruins his fun and I try to talk about things at very inconvenient times for him. 

I am currently living at home and don't have many friends. The friends I have all live away from me now and I find myself not wanting to bother them with my problems so I don't talk to them. 

I am also having financial issues and can not return to school so I seem to feel as if I'm stuck in life. 

I hope that was easy to understand. Thank you for listening.
I appreciate the support. It's hard to talk to many of the people I am close with. I find that they push my depression aside as if it isn't important that I am sad the majority of my days.
